assumptions: rights_split_pct values above 1 are percentages and values from 0 through 1 are fractions.
payable_revenue is semantically equivalent to the former net_amount after provider fees.
Canonical downstream names artist_share and net_amount remain stable during migration.

files.proposedContent:
-- synthetic: true
-- source incident: inc-2026-07-dsp-001
-- context snapshot: recorded-datahub-context-replay
with provider_v1 as (
    select
        settlement_id,
        dsp_name,
        reporting_month,
        isrc,
        artist_id,
        territory_code,
        stream_count,
        gross_revenue,
        platform_fee,
        cast(artist_share as decimal(18, 6)) as artist_share,
        cast(net_amount as decimal(18, 2)) as net_amount,
        currency,
        payout_status,
        'provider-v1' as source_schema_version,
        artist_share is null or artist_share < 0 or artist_share > 1 as invalid_rights_split
    from {{ ref('raw_dsp_settlements_v1') }}
),

provider_v2 as (
    select
        settlement_id,
        dsp_name,
        reporting_month,
        isrc,
        artist_id,
        territory_code,
        stream_count,
        gross_revenue,
        platform_fee,
        cast(
            case
                when rights_split_pct between 0 and 1 then rights_split_pct
                when rights_split_pct > 1 and rights_split_pct <= 100 then rights_split_pct / 100.0
                else null
            end as decimal(18, 6)
        ) as artist_share,
        cast(payable_revenue as decimal(18, 2)) as net_amount,
        currency,
        payout_status,
        'provider-v2' as source_schema_version,
        rights_split_pct is null or rights_split_pct < 0 or rights_split_pct > 100 as invalid_rights_split
    from {{ ref('raw_dsp_settlements_v2') }}
)

select * from provider_v1
union all
select * from provider_v2

version: 2

models:
  - name: stg_dsp_streams
    description: Backward-compatible synthetic DSP staging model for provider schema v1 and v2.
    columns:
      - name: settlement_id
        description: Synthetic settlement identifier.
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: artist_share
        description: Canonical artist share stored as a fraction from zero through one.
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: net_amount
        description: Canonical payable revenue after the platform fee.
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: source_schema_version
        tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: ['provider-v1', 'provider-v2']
      - name: invalid_rights_split
        description: Quarantine signal for null or out-of-range source share values.

  - name: int_royalty_calculation
    description: Calculates the synthetic artist payout from canonical fields.
    columns:
      - name: settlement_id
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: artist_payout_amount
        tests: [not_null]

  - name: royalty_ledger
    description: Synthetic royalty ledger used by payment consumers.

  - name: artist_monthly_payout
    description: Synthetic monthly payout totals by artist and currency.

+where not invalid_rights_split
+group by 1
+having abs(sum(net_amount) - sum(gross_revenue - platform_fee)) > 0.01

files.proposedContent:
# DSP Settlement Schema Migration — July 2026

Synthetic example generated by `contextpatch-deterministic-mock-v1` for incident `inc-2026-07-dsp-001` from a recorded DataHub context snapshot.

## Change

- `artist_share` is replaced by `rights_split_pct`; observed values indicate mixed fraction and percentage units.
- `net_amount` is replaced by `payable_revenue` with compatible currency semantics in the supplied evidence.

## Strategy

Keep canonical downstream fields stable. Normalize `rights_split_pct` values from 0–1 as fractions and values above 1 through 100 as percentages. Quarantine null, negative, or above-100 values. Union the old and new synthetic source fixtures during the migration window.

## Validation

Run dbt parse, compile, build, schema/range tests, old/new/mixed fixture compatibility, and payable-total reconciliation. Currency tolerance is 0.01; no other unexplained amount drift is accepted.

## Rollback

Revert the approved patch, restore contract version 1, and quarantine provider-v2 input until the provider restores v1 or confirms corrected semantics. Do not delete new-source evidence.

## Unresolved assumption

The provider must confirm whether a value exactly equal to `1` always means 100% rather than 1%.

Validation status: pending deterministic execution and human approval.
